name: βk-IVP
summary: The beta-ketone analogue of IVP, this is a rare RC stimulant in the same family as MDPV. Little is known but it is suspected that the effects are similar to MDPV, amphetamine, or high dose caffeine.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Its exact action has not been measured. Compounds of the pyrovalerone family, such as MDPV, block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline strongly, which is thought to be how this one works too.
pharmacology.zh: 它的確切作用尚未被測定。pyrovalerone 家族的化合物如 MDPV 會強力阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收，一般認為它的作用方式也是如此。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的确切作用尚未被测定。pyrovalerone 家族的化合物如 MDPV 会强力阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收，一般认为它的作用方式也是如此。

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical sold as a stimulant. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是作為興奮劑販售的罕見研究化學品，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是作为兴奋剂贩售的罕见研究化学品，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, such as MDPV, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, days of sleeplessness, paranoia and psychosis, with compulsive redosing and a high risk of dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同家族藥物如 MDPV 可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、連續數日失眠、妄想與精神病，並伴隨強迫性連續補用與高度成癮風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同家族药物如 MDPV 可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、连续数日失眠、妄想与精神病，并伴随强迫性连续补用与高度成瘾风险。

fact.en: Like MDPV, it belongs to the pyrovalerone family, built around a pyrrolidine ring attached to the side chain. Compounds of this family are strong dopamine reuptake blockers.
fact.zh: 和 MDPV 一樣，它屬於 pyrovalerone 家族，結構核心是接在側鏈上的吡咯烷環。這個家族的化合物是強效的多巴胺回收阻斷劑。
fact.zhHans: 和 MDPV 一样，它属于 pyrovalerone 家族，结构内核是接在侧链上的吡咯烷环。这个家族的化合物是强效的多巴胺回收阻断剂。
